The signed augmented Lefschetz sum over permutation-invariant occupied vertex orbits, cyclic run automaton, and folded reflection run-cap generating function give the stated complete rational dihedral trace formulas, including n=r+2 endpoint and the two reflection axis types. A fresh independent orbit enumerator reproduced 548 cases for r=2..5 and modest n; more decisively, an entirely separate derivation from published N(n,k) character formulas and equivariant Alexander duality agreed EXACTLY on 79,380 r,n,g samples. The infinity claim rests on the general orbit/automaton proof, not the finite checks.
